newsitem.title: USA: Cytec ups shares, sees estimates reasonable.
newsitem.headline: Cytec ups shares, sees estimates reasonable.

text.p: Cytec Industries Inc said Monday that its stockholders had approved doubling the company's authorized common to 150 million from 75 million.
The specialty chemicals company also said it believes current analysts estimates for the year are reasonable.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report full-year 1997 earnings of $2.36, according to First Call.

"We are pleased with our progress so far this year, with first quarter sales gains on continuing business of nine percent. We continue to make internal improvements in the company, and we are optimistic about top-line growth for the remainder of the year," the company said in a statement. "We feel the current consensus of analysts estimates for the year are reasonable."

The company said the newly authorized shares would be available for possible future acquisitions, financing, stock dividends, stock splits or other stock distributions, but added that none of the uses are presently under consideration.
Cytec shares were up 1/4 Monday afternoon at 38-3/4.
